newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices pressured by bearish Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices pressured by bearish Tokyo.

text.p: Thailand's rubber market continued its bearish trend this week on sluggish demand and weak Tokyo prices, traders said on Friday.
The market attracted short covering from Japanese and European players, but the amount was modest as buyers waited for prices to fall further, they said.
"Europeans started buying before going on holiday so they won't have to worry about positions," said a Hat Yai trader.
"But overall the market was bearish," he said.
Next week's spot contract expiry has put pressure on prices and slow trade was expected next week.
"I don't anticipate any new leads that will move the market up in the near term," said another trader.

Thai benchmark RSS3 for August delivery was quoted around 108.00-108.50 US cents a kg FOB Bangkok, compared with 112.00 cents last week. September was quoted around 109.00 on the same basis, compared with 112.50 a week earlier.
